text:
Samir Patel: quick sync after the residency RFC. we keep seeing edge races when capacity shifts. proposal: lightweight route leases issued by control-plane and included by proxy in requests (X-Route-Lease). aim: prevent split-writes and give proxy a cheap way to know current owner. thoughts?
Leah Gomez: sounds useful. main worry: what happens if a lease expires mid-request? we can't do a rolling re-route.
Anna Chen: invariant: runtime only checks lease at start-of-request. if it expires while processing, the request proceeds. we should document that explicitly.
Miguel Torres: how does proxy get leases w/o adding large latency? synchronous control-plane calls on every request are a no-go.
Samir Patel: plan: proxy caches per-tenant lease with configurable TTL (default 30s). proxy refreshes at 70% TTL in background. on cache miss proxy does a sync fetch but with tight budget (25ms).
Leah Gomez: what about conflicting writes if two proxies fetch different leases around the same time? need fencing.
Anna Chen: include epoch in lease token and sign it. token = tenant|epoch|lease_id|sig. runtimes reject requests with epoch < last_seen_epoch -> respond 409 lease_conflict. that gives fencing semantics.
Miguel Torres: signing implies KMS usage. note: key rotation needs to be handled. ops-bot: ksm-rotation-2026-03 scheduled; design should tolerate rotated keys.
Samir Patel: control-plane will issue signed_token plus metadata {expires_at, epoch}. proxy sends header X-Route-Lease: <signed_token>. data-plane validates signature and compares epoch to last applied epoch for tenant. older epoch -> 409.
Leah Gomez: 409 is fine. need a documented client retry path: backoff + refetch lease. for some tenants we might want automatic retry.
Anna Chen: optional behavior: tenant profile flag prefer_failover=true. if set, proxy auto-refetches lease and retries once on 409 (sync). otherwise we surface 409 to client.
Miguel Torres: metrics we should add: lease_fetch_latency_ms, lease_refresh_failures_total, write_fenced_conflicts_total, lease_retry_success_total. ops-bot: note: last canary showed lease_refresh_failures +7% on one zone.
Samir Patel: observability: add header X-Route-Lease-Src: cache|fresh to indicate proxy used cached token vs freshly fetched. also X-Fallback-Reason when proxy routes away from resident region (e.g., local-capacity).
Leah Gomez: rollout strategy: unsigned leases for shadow testing -> accept unsigned and signed for migration -> flip to signed-only. feature flag gating to control enforcement.
Anna Chen: example request snippet:
```
POST /v1/complete
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer <token>
X-Residency: prefer
X-Route-Lease: tenant123|42|lid-7f2|sig-zzzz
X-Route-Lease-Src: cache
```
response when write is fenced:
```
HTTP/1.1 409 Conflict
Content-Type: application/json
X-Request-Id: r-abc123

{ "error":"lease_conflict", "hint":"refetch_lease" }
```
Samir Patel: runtime invariant: verify lease before any state mutation. if token invalid or older epoch -> reject before performing side-effects. document as runtime contract.
Miguel Torres: CI: add integration test simulating parallel writers and staggered lease expiry. assert one writer succeeds, others 409; if prefer_failover=true proxy retry flow should succeed in one additional attempt. ops-bot: task created: ci/leases/parallel-fence added.
Leah Gomez: make TTL configurable per-tenant. compliance tenants may want short TTLs (5s). default 30s is fine.
Anna Chen: signing details: token signature uses control-plane KMS key; include key-id in token so runtime can find right verifier. also ensure signed_token doesn't expose sensitive info; redact in logs.
Samir Patel: also add header X-Residency-Decision: local|routed|blocked for telemetry. X-Routed-From if routed away from resident region.
Miguel Torres: dashboards: lease_age_distribution, per-region refetch_latency heatmap, write_fence_rate. add alert if lease_refresh_failures spike.
Samir Patel: security: redact tokens in logs, retention policy for lease audit events needs review by security. ops-bot: security-review-request created.
Leah Gomez: migration checklist: 1) control-plane issue unsigned leases and proxy annotates requests (no enforcement) 2) data-plane accepts either signed or unsigned (warning logs) 3) start issuing signed tokens and enable verifier, 4) flip enforcement via feature flag. document timeline + rollback.
Anna Chen: I'll draft spec with headers, token format, migration steps, and examples. aim to share by EOD Tue.
Miguel Torres: I'll add CI tests and dashboard PR.
Samir Patel: I'll prototype signer + key rotation handling. final ask: confirm that 409 never leads to partial durable writes. Leah to add runtime doc for apply-on-commit after lease verification.
Leah Gomez: will add that guarantee to runtime invariants doc.
Samir Patel: ok can people ack? :thumbsup:
Anna Chen: :thumbsup:
Leah Gomez: :thumbsup:
Miguel Torres: :thumbsup:
ops-bot: scheduled-task: lease-fencing-migration added to milestones with tag lease-fencing
